payload.text: hv's ruling of 2026-11-17, given to vc in the live channel (vc's window, read at 07:52Z by vc's date -u), in hv's wording, recorded by vc as mediator. vc told hv that the Herdr panel refreshes itself every five minutes, that r reaches it only through a line hv adds to keys.json ("mod:ccusage": {"r": "ccusage.refresh"}), and that the panel's refresh, unlike the TUI's r, does not force a fetch; vc asked: should the panel's r force a fresh fetch the way the TUI's does? If yes, it is a small change for ic in the same next release. hv: "yes". vc's reading: in the next release, the command a key sends to the panel, ccusage.refresh, fetches every account at once, as the TUI's r does, within any rate-limit cooldown; the five-minute timer stays as it is; the command keeps its name, so hv's keys.json line works unchanged.
